```{r concordance, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
source_file <- file.path("..", "tools", "qualification", "METHOD_CONCORDANCE.md")
method_text <- readLines(source_file, warn = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(method_text[[1L]], "# Method concordance"))
# The numerical boundary is included below; its source-relative link belongs
# to the standalone Markdown file rather than the installed vignette.
method_text <- sub("[numerical qualification](README.md)",
                   "numerical qualification", method_text, fixed = TRUE)
cat(method_text[-c(1L, 2L)], sep = "\n")
```
